post.description:
Initialize this node as the leader of a new cluster

This operation may only be performed against a node which has not been
initialized and is not currently a member of a cluster.

Remove a node from the cluster.

This operation executes immediately and the node must be wiped and reset
before it can safely be added to the cluster.

post.description:
Receives messages from a topic using a consumer group.

Each consumer in the group reads from all partitions. Messages are locked by leases for the
specified duration to prevent duplicate delivery within the same consumer group.

x-codeSamples.label: Go
x-codeSamples.source:
response, err := diom.Msgs.Stream.Receive(
    ctx,
    "some_topic_name",
    "some_consumer_group",
    MsgStreamReceiveIn{
        Namespace: new("some_namespace"),
        BatchSize: new(uint16(1)),
        LeaseDuration: new(diom.DurationMs(30000)),
        DefaultStartingPosition: new(SEEKPOSITION_EARLIEST),
        BatchWait: new(diom.DurationMs(30000)),
    },
)

post.description:
Commits an offset for a consumer group on a specific partition.

The topic must be a partition-level topic (e.g. `ns:my-topic~3`). The offset is the last
successfully processed offset; future receives will start after it.

x-codeSamples.label: Go
JavaScript

post.description:
Repositions a consumer group's read cursor on a topic.

Provide exactly one of `offset`, `position`, or `timestamp`. When using `offset`, the topic
must include a partition suffix (e.g. `ns:my-topic~0`). The `position` field accepts
`"earliest"` or `"latest"` and may be used with or without a partition suffix. The `timestamp`
field accepts a Unix timestamp in milliseconds and seeks to the first message at or after that
time.

x-codeSamples.label: Go
x-codeSamples.source:
response, err := diom.Msgs.Stream.Seek(
    ctx,
    "some_topic_name",
    "some_consumer_group",
    MsgStreamSeekIn{
        Namespace: new("some_namespace"),
        Offset: new(uint64(1)),
        Position: new(SEEKPOSITION_EARLIEST),
        Timestamp: new(diom.Timestamp(time.Date(2026, 04, 20, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))),
    },
)

post.description:
Receives messages from a topic as competing consumers.

Messages are individually leased for the specified duration. Multiple consumers can receive
different messages from the same topic concurrently. Leased messages are skipped until they
are acked or their lease expires.

post.description:
Configures retry and DLQ behavior for a consumer group on a topic.

`retry_schedule` is a list of delays (in millis) between retries after a nack. Once exhausted,
the message is moved to the DLQ (or forwarded to `dlq_topic` if set).

move them back to the queue for reprocessing.

get.description:
Verify the server is up and running.

This endpoint only checks the server itself, not the cluster mechanism, and should not be used
as a readiness gate.
Verify that this server is ready to serve customer traffic.

iterator.description: The iterator returned from a prior invocation

expiry_ms.description: Milliseconds from now until the token expires.

enabled.description: Whether the token is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

expiry_ms.description: Milliseconds from now until the token expires. `None` means expire immediately.

snapshot_time.description: The wall-clock time at which the snapshot was initiated

snapshot_log_index.description: The log index at which the snapshot was initiated

snapshot_id.description: If this is `null`, the snapshot is still building in the background

cluster_id.description:
The unique ID of this cluster.

This value is populated on cluster initialization and will never change.

cluster_name.description:
The name of this cluster (as defined in the config)

This value is not replicated and should only be used for debugging.

this_node_id.description: The unique ID of the node servicing this request

this_node_state.description: The cluster state of the node servicing this request

this_node_last_committed_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the last transaction committed on this node

this_node_last_snapshot_id.description: The last snapshot taken on this node

this_node_last_purged_log_index.description: The last-purged log on this node

nodes.description: A list of all nodes known to be in the cluster

Consistency.description:
Consistency level for reads.

Strong consistency (also known as linearizability) guarantees that a read will see all previous
writes. Weak consistency allows stale reads, but can save one or more round trip to the leader.

HttpSinkConfig.description:
Configuration for an HTTP sink. The `url`, `headers`, and `body` are templates rendered
per-message (see [`diom_core::template_str`]).

body.description: Templated request body. When absent, the raw message value bytes are sent unchanged.

context.description: Optional metadata to store alongside the response

ttl_ms.description: How long to keep the idempotency response for.

lock_period_ms.description: How long to hold the lock on start before releasing it.

oneOf.description: Request was already completed, cached response returned

version.description:
If set, the delete only succeeds when the stored version matches this value.
Use the `version` field from a prior `get` response.

success.description: Whether the operation succeeded or was a noop due to pre-conditions.

version.description:
Opaque version token for optimistic concurrency control.
Pass as `version` in a subsequent `set` to perform a conditional write.

If set, the write only succeeds when the stored version matches this value.
Use the `version` field from a prior `get` response.

attributes.description: Key/Value pairs attached to this sequence

value.description:
Most recent data point for this series

All points (u64, i64, and f64) are squished into an f64, be careful
of inexactness for values above 2**53.

metric_type.description:
Type of this metric

Histograms are not currently exported through this API, and can
only be accessed through OTLP.

unit.description:
Optional unit, following UCUM unit conventions if possible

See https://ucum.org/ for details

key.description:
Optional partition key.

Messages with the same key are routed to the same partition.

delay_ms.description:
Optional delay in milliseconds.

The message will not be delivered to queue consumers
until the delay has elapsed from the time of publish.

batch_wait_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for messages before returning.
Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for messages before returning.

node_id.description:
A unique ID representing this node.

This will never change unless the node is erased and reset

address.description: The advertised inter-server (cluster) address of this node.

state.description: The last known state of this node

last_committed_log_index.description: The index of the last log applied on this node

last_committed_term.description: The raft term of the last committed leadership

retry_after_ms.description: Milliseconds until enough tokens are available (only present when allowed is false)

refill_amount.description: Number of tokens to add per refill interval

refill_interval_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds between refills (minimum 1 millisecond)

retry_after_ms.description: Milliseconds until at least one token is available (only present when remaining is 0)

The topic whose messages are forwarded to the sink. Created automatically if it does not

consumer_group.description: The consumer group that identifies the sink and tracks its progress through the topic.

default_starting_position.description: Where a freshly-created sink starts consuming the topic. Defaults to `earliest`.

max_in_flight.description: At most how many concurrent requests will be sent to the Sink.
